title.en: The gap: acting inside your control
title.id: Celah itu: bertindak di dalam kendalimu

sources: Written for this lesson from its own objectives and reading: the space between stimulus and response, reactive and ownership language, and initiative that needs nobody's permission. The ideas are long-established and taught here in the lesson's own words. The story and the character are invented. No third-party script, footage, picture or sound.

sub.id: Rasa memiliki: bertindak di dalam kendalimu

say.en: Ten at night. A message from a teammate: I have not started my part. The presentation is tomorrow.
say.id: Pukul sepuluh malam. Pesan dari rekan sekelompok: bagianku belum kukerjakan. Presentasinya besok.

say.en: Sinta's thumbs are already typing something sharp.
say.id: Jempol Sinta sudah mengetik balasan yang pedas.

say.en: But between the message and her reply there is a gap. It is about two seconds wide.
say.id: Tapi di antara pesan itu dan balasannya ada celah. Lebarnya kira-kira dua detik.

foot.en: Ownership is refusing to let the stimulus *write your reply*.
foot.id: Rasa memiliki berarti menolak membiarkan stimulus *menulis balasanmu*.

p.en: The message. Fixed. *She did not choose it.*

say.en: The stimulus is fixed. She did not choose it.
say.id: Stimulusnya sudah terjadi. Itu bukan pilihannya.

say.en: The gap is where she chooses.
And the response is entirely hers.
Ownership is not hustle or aggression. It is refusing to let the stimulus write your reply.
say.id: Rasa memiliki bukan berarti agresif atau sok sibuk. Artinya menolak membiarkan stimulus menulis balasanmu.

text.en: You always make me do everything.
text.id: Kamu selalu bikin aku mengerjakan semuanya.

text.en: *I choose* to finish slide four tonight. Can you send five and six by eight?
text.id: *Aku memilih* menyelesaikan slide empat malam ini. Bisa kirim slide lima dan enam sebelum pukul delapan?

say.en: Her first draft: you always make me do everything. That sentence hands the pen to him.
say.id: Draf pertamanya: kamu selalu bikin aku mengerjakan semuanya. Kalimat itu menyerahkan pena kepadanya.

say.en: The second draft begins with I choose. She finishes slide four tonight, and asks for the last two by eight.
say.id: Draf kedua dibuka dengan aku memilih. Ia menyelesaikan slide empat malam ini, dan meminta dua slide terakhir sebelum pukul delapan.

kicker.en: Your language is a live diagnostic

p.en: “I have to.” “They made me.” “There is nothing I can do.”
p.id: “Aku terpaksa.” “Mereka yang membuatku begini.” “Aku tidak bisa apa-apa.”

p.en: “I choose.” “I will.” “Here is what *I can* do.”

say.en: Your language is a live diagnostic. I have to, they made me, there is nothing I can do: these are reactive tells.
say.id: Bahasamu adalah alat diagnosis yang bekerja seketika. Aku terpaksa, mereka yang membuatku begini, aku tidak bisa apa-apa: itu tanda reaktif.

say.en: I choose, I will, here is what I can do: these are ownership tells.
say.id: Aku memilih, aku akan, ini yang bisa kulakukan: itu tanda rasa memiliki.

say.en: Listen to yourself for one day, and count.
say.id: Dengarkan dirimu sendiri selama satu hari, lalu hitung.

keys.id: Satu hal yang *tak diminta siapa pun*.

say.en: The next morning she does one thing nobody asked for: a one-page checklist for the group's next project.
say.id: Keesokan paginya ia mengerjakan satu hal yang tak diminta siapa pun: daftar periksa satu halaman untuk proyek kelompok berikutnya.

say.en: Initiative inside your control needs no permission. That is exactly why interviewers ask for examples of it.
say.id: Inisiatif di dalam kendalimu tidak butuh izin. Justru karena itulah pewawancara meminta contohnya.

points.en: The stimulus is fixed. *The response is yours.*
Your words show *who holds the pen*.

turn.en: Pick one frustrating moment from this week. Find the gap, and rewrite your reply.
turn.id: Pilih satu kejadian menjengkelkan minggu ini. Temukan celahnya, lalu tulis ulang balasanmu.

say.en: The stimulus is fixed. The response is yours.
Your words show who holds the pen.
say.id: Kata-katamu menunjukkan siapa yang memegang pena.

say.en: Now it is your turn. Pick one frustrating moment from this week. Find the gap, and rewrite your reply.
say.id: Sekarang giliranmu. Pilih satu kejadian menjengkelkan minggu ini. Temukan celahnya, lalu tulis ulang balasanmu.
